name: Welcome to Port Haven
source: You will follow Oliver and Gina, two longtime college friends who might be more than just friends. Their journey unfolds in Port Haven—a sprawling metropolis and the financial and media capital of the world—where, as fresh graduates, they begin an internship at BergMedia, a globally renowned advertising agency. In a city filled with as many opportunities as challenges, will their dreams come true, or will the city corrupt them? Their fate is in your hands.​
